recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed; future maintenance of these links should occur in HL7/fhir-extensions if the Gender Harmony IG URL or extension-pack publication surface changes.
issue_request: FHIR-40556 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Patient Administration change request to add links to the Gender Harmony Implementation Guide from the Gender Identity and Recorded Sex or Gender extension descriptions.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was pre-applied in HL7/fhir-extensions#13. Extension-pack commit c186373bb2a91e93d528b078dbeb45015b886234 added the GHIG link to the descriptions of StructureDefinition-individual-genderIdentity.xml and StructureDefinition-individual-recordedSexOrGender.xml.
additional_context: The current extension-pack IG treats input/definitions/* as resource input, and both current extension descriptions still include the Gender Harmony Implementation Guide link. Core FHIR references the canonical extensions from Patient examples/narrative but does not own the GI or RSG extension definition source files.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch and made no core source edits because the applied source belongs to the FHIR Extension Pack.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request to add Gender Harmony Implementation Guide links to the Gender Identity and Recorded Sex or Gender extension descriptions.
evidence_items.learned: The final WG request was specifically extension-description wording, and the Jira comment identifies HL7/fhir-extensions#13 as the pre-application.

evidence_items.summary: Both current extension descriptions include a Markdown link to the Gender Harmony Implementation Guide.
evidence_items.learned: The requested links are already present in the repository that owns the extension definitions.

evidence_items.summary: Commit 'FHIR-40556 (pre-applied)' changed the GI and RSG StructureDefinition descriptions to append the Gender Harmony Implementation Guide link.
evidence_items.learned: The source-history implementation matches the Jira comment and the current extension-pack contents.

evidence_items.summary: The extension-pack IG declares input/definitions/* as a path-resource input.
evidence_items.learned: The GI and RSG StructureDefinition files are active extension-pack build inputs, confirming the request belongs to the extension-pack source surface.

evidence_items.locator: Core checkout search for Gender Harmony extension definitions
evidence_items.command: rg -n 'individual-genderIdentity|individual-recordedSexOrGender|Gender Harmony Implementation Guide' source; git ls-files | rg 'individual-genderIdentity|individual-recordedSexOrGender'
evidence_items.summary: Core source has Patient narrative/examples referencing the extension canonical URLs but no active source files defining the GI or RSG extensions.
evidence_items.learned: The core checkout is not the owner of the requested extension-description text, so a core source change would be misplaced.

evidence_items.summary: Patient Administration minutes record a motion to approve FHIR-40556 by Line Saele / Reinhard Egelkraut, 8-0-1.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence supports the Jira vote and final disposition.
